text: Who should grant you, O my beloved man, nursing the breasts of my mother; finding you outside I should kiss you, and indeed, they will not treat me with contempt.

I shall take you; I shall bring you into the house of my mother, and into the inner chamber of the one conceiving me. I will give you to drink from [[2]wine ; [1]scented] of the juice of my pomegranates.
His left hand is; under ; my head, and ; his right hand; shall embrace me.
I bound you by an oath, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers, by the strengths of the field, why should you arise and why should you awaken ; love until whenever it should want?

Who is this ; ascending from the wilderness, staying upon ; her beloved man? Under the apple tree; I awakened you. There [[2]travailed [3]with you ; [1]your mother]. There she travailed with you, ; giving birth to you.
Set me as a seal upon ; your heart, as a seal upon ; your arm! For [[3]is strong [4]as [5]death [1]the [2]love]; hard as Hades is jealousy; her sparks are sparks of the fire of her flames.
[[2]water [1]Much] will not be able to extinguish ; love, and rivers shall not engulf it. If [[2]should give [1]a man] all ; his livelihood for ; love, with contempt men will treat it contemptuously.
Our sister is small and [[3]breasts [2]no [1]has]; what shall we do ; for our sister in the day in which ever she should be spoken for in it?
If she is a wall, we should build upon her parapets of silver. And if she is a door, we will circumscribe for her [[2]plank [1]cedar].
I am; a wall, and ; my breasts are as towers. I was in their eyes as one finding peace.
A Vineyard existed to; Solomon in Baal-hamon. He gave over ; his vineyard to the ones keeping it. Every man shall bring for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.
My vineyard, mine, is before me. The thousands to Solomon, and ; two hundred to the ones keeping ; its fruit.
O one sitting down in the gardens, the companions are taking heed to; your voice. You caused me to hear!
Flee, O my beloved man, and be like the doe or the fawn of the hinds upon mountains of aromatics!
